name: 雾蓝提花缎边毛巾二件套款

shots.intent: 无模特静物开场，用提花缎边与雾蓝绿意氛围一秒建立轻柔质感与点击欲
shots.textZone: upper-left eyebrow chip plus two-line headline zone, rest clean

shots.intent: 把掉毛、褪色、吸水慢、越用越硬四类日常困扰做成徽章墙，为提花缎边方案铺垫
shots.textZone: left 2x2 badge grid, each card one short label; headline top-left

shots.intent: 六宫格线描图标把核心卖点结构化成一眼可读的背书墙，承接痛点给出理由
shots.textZone: centred two-line header above a 3x2 icon card grid, one label per card

shots.intent: 把毛圈组织、平整缎边与印染色泽三段微距编号并列，用可见构造证明做工
shots.textZone: numbered 01/02/03 blocks to the right of each band, one header plus two short labels per block

shots.intent: 竹托、皂块与毛刷的浴室静物把巾子放进真实使用语境，传递亲肤柔软手感
shots.textZone: top-centred serif headline with a short sub-line and a thin rule

shots.intent: 极低角度微距水珠被毛圈吸下的瞬间，把吸水机制解释成看得见的画面
shots.textZone: one small annotation chip near the droplet and a short headline top-left

shots.intent: 折叠堆与六枚色标吊牌同框，用一屏讲清选色空间并促成颜色决策
shots.textZone: centred serif header plus a six-tag colour column, each tab with one short label and a round chip

shots.intent: 俯视平铺把二件套两片尺寸差异摊在同一比例尺上，消除买错规格疑虑
shots.textZone: header top-centre, one caption chip under each piece, two dashed spec rows at the base

shots.intent: 结构化规格卡加洗护要点收束理性决策，把首次使用与洗涤顾虑讲在前面
shots.textZone: serif header top-centre, four dashed spec rows on the right, three numbered care notes across the base

shots.intent: 低角度三色叠堆加行动按钮收束全篇，把成套购买的冲动落到一个动作上
shots.textZone: upper headline zone plus a bottom-centre button

style.backgroundSystem: ivory white seamless backdrops, pale misty-blue gradient panels and faint white marble veining; quiet bathroom-shelf space, never a busy room

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent serene jacquard bath-textile ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ivory white #F7F4EF, misty blue #DCE7F2, warm charcoal text #3F3A37 and one jacquard indigo accent #2F6BB0, with muted sage #4E9C86 and warm camel #7C6A62 used only as product colorway references; cool-neutral soft diffused daylight around 6000K from the upper left, airy highlights, gentle pooled shadows and a light contact shadow grounding every fold; Song-style serif display headlines with airy letter spacing paired with a light geometric sans body, one type system per screen; thin single-weight line icons centred in white rounded cards with a short misty-blue underline tick; backgrounds are ivory seamless, pale misty-blue gradient panels and faint white marble veining, never busy rooms; folded towel geometry stays true with dense even cut-pile terry loops, a flat crisp woven jacquard border band and clean hem stitching, never printed-on faux jacquard; stable product scale and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no people or faces.
noDrift: no shifting loop-pile density or border-band pattern between shots
no invented jacquard motif replacing the reference motif
style.presentationRules: folded geometry stays true: dense even cut-pile terry loops, flat crisp woven jacquard border band, clean hem stitching, no printed-on faux jacquard; stable scale and centring across the set, product always grounded by contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: ivory matte shelf and pale marble counter, shallow bamboo tray or white quilted textile as the only surface breaks
style.typography: Song-style serif display headlines with airy letter spacing paired with a light geometric sans body; one type system per screen, Chinese copy in #3F3A37; no handwriting, no cartoon, no mixed families on a single screen
